topic: Expert C++ Implementation Concept: Recursive Mutexes and Compiler Optimization
explanation: This explores the implementation of recursive mutexes (e.g., `std::recursive_timed_mutex`), focusing on how compilers handle the complexities of ownership tracking, potential compiler optimizations, and the resulting memory layout and performance implications.  We will examine the interplay between compile-time and runtime behavior, and consider assembly-level details where relevant.
